definitions.full: H2463. Chelbon חֶלְבּוֺן proper name, of a location place whence wine came (to Tyre) ח ׳יֵין Ezek 27:18 ; so also Assyrian proper name, of a territory –ilbunim or Hilbunu , see Schr COT and Dl in Co. Modern –albûn, northwest from Damascus, Wetzst ZMG xi. 1857, 490 f. Bd Pal 341 .
